SELECT n.id AS notificationId, n.sender_id AS senderId, u.nickname AS senderName, u.avatar AS senderAvatar, n.target_id AS articleId, a.title AS articleTitle, a.like_count AS articleLikeCount, n.create_time AS createTime, n.is_read AS isRead FROM notification n LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = n.sender_id LEFT JOIN article a ON a.id = n.target_id WHERE n.target_id = #{articleId} AND n.target_type = 1 AND n.type = 1 AND n.is_read = 0 AND n.deleted = 0 ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
